# libcoap / block_fuzzer

libcoap's own fuzz target `block_fuzzer` ([source](source/block_target.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libcoap (obgm/libcoap at 19bc71e6).

No summary of this harness is recorded yet; its checks, if any, are listed below.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libcoap at commit 19bc71e6.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Statements ([Statements.v](Statements.v))

**Some statements are blocked by the model.** On the inputs they cover, the binary uses non-blocking descriptors and uses sockets, which this release's model does not decode, so the statements marked "blocked by the model" are false in this model for that reason alone. The program is not at fault.

| statement | in one line | status |
|---|---|---|
| `plain_halts` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | blocked by the model: the binary uses non-blocking descriptors and uses sockets |
| `ubsan_halts` | on every input on which the UBSan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | blocked by the model: the binary uses non-blocking descriptors and uses sockets |
| `asan_halts` | on every input on which the ASan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | blocked by the model: the binary uses sockets |
| `asan_ubsan_halts` | on every input on which the ASan+UBSan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | blocked by the model: the binary uses sockets |
| `asan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 2 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; ASan never fires; memory refused only when forced | blocked by the model: the binary uses non-blocking descriptors and uses sockets |
| `ubsan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; UBSan never fires; memory refused only when forced | blocked by the model: the binary uses non-blocking descriptors and uses sockets |
| `asan_ubsan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 2 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; ASan+UBSan never fires; memory refused only when forced | blocked by the model: the binary uses non-blocking descriptors and uses sockets |
